name: Percentage calculations
subject: Mathematical Literacy
example_problem: A jacket priced at R850 is discounted by 15%, then 15% VAT is added to the discounted price. Calculate the final price, and the single percentage change from the original price.
prior_knowledge: Fractions and decimals; multiplication and division

importance.summary: Finance is Question 2 on every Paper 1 (Gr 10 75 marks -> Gr 11 100 -> Gr 12 150), and percentages run through VAT, interest, inflation and tariff work; Q1's 20% level-1 marks lean on it too.
